title: Shared canonical/manual architecture
acceptance_criteria: The implemented canonical and manual workflows both start from `Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project/` and converge on the same required project identity, governed assets, Memory System procedure, and verification outcomes.
observed_result: Final source and active 17-case suites plus independent direct/nested routes use one template, six assets and installed bootstrap.

title: Source and active initializer packages
acceptance_criteria: Both skill packages exist at their approved source and active paths, have a documented source-to-destination relationship, pass their package checks, and do not claim automatic synchronization after adoption.
observed_result: Nine-file exact source/active manifests, recorded reviewed adoption and both final 17-case suites; no ongoing asset propagation.

title: Exact registered template
acceptance_criteria: The root workflow resolves that exact registered path, verifies that it is still identified as `kind: project-template`, and rejects an ambiguous, missing, or substituted template path.
observed_result: Production resolver and registry schema/substitution/identity cases require the exact registered project-template path.

title: Clean seed before new runtime
acceptance_criteria: A created project contains the approved starter inventory and does not contain `.venv`, `.ruff_cache`, `.DS_Store`, `__pycache__`, `.sys4ai/memory`, provider databases, model caches, or template-generated runtime state.
observed_result: Allowlist tests exclude every template environment, cache, OS/Git and derived artifact before publication. Subsequent newly created .venv and .sys4ai are required by REQ-018, not copied template state.

title: Specialized identity
acceptance_criteria: The resulting README and governed configuration contain the approved project identity, no active artifact identifies the product as “Sys4AI Template Project,” and the stable ID is unique in the registry.
observed_result: Direct and manual README/project.json/config, unique registry IDs and source/destination receipts verified, including malformed/reserved/collision refusals.

title: Factual transactional inventory
acceptance_criteria: The registry contains one schema-valid entry with the approved stable ID and real root-relative path, and it does not invent a repository, remote, publication, or deployment state.
observed_result: One schema-valid exact relative entry; stale/hash/ID/path conflicts refuse and reruns do not duplicate. Own Git marker/top-level required; no parent identity inheritance.

title: Six complete baseline skills
acceptance_criteria: A new project contains complete validated copies of exactly the six baseline packages from their reviewed source versions, and no additional or future skill package is installed without explicit selection.
observed_result: Exact package content hashes and per-package source/destination versions for exactly six adopted packages. Portable adopted-package checks pass; unchanged producer-only failures explicitly classified.

title: Baseline soul copy
acceptance_criteria: The new project’s `SOUL.md` is a verified project-local copy of the reviewed `SOULS-depo/SOUL.md` source, no additional or alternative soul is installed without explicit selection, and later source changes do not silently alter the project copy.
observed_result: All actual consumer SOUL hashes match the reviewed SOULS-depo source, no alternative installed, later source edits leave copies unchanged.

title: Independent project ownership
acceptance_criteria: Documentation and behavior state that no reusable-source change propagates automatically and that every later refresh requires a new exact project-local adoption decision and verification.
observed_result: Explicit adoption records and source-edit/no-op tests preserve project-owned copies. Current docs require separately scoped later refresh.

title: One shared memory procedure
acceptance_criteria: All three entry paths resolve the same configuration, path-isolation, validation, and verification contracts without duplicating executable initialization logic, while entry-specific authorization behavior follows the applicable requirements.
observed_result: Direct create/manual and live root reviewed entry delegate to the same installed configuration/preflight/storage code; only root uses impact digest.

title: Portable manual guide
acceptance_criteria: The template README has a valid relative link to `INIT_MEMORY.md`, the guide clearly states that the template itself is not initialized, and a copied project agent can identify the canonical initialization procedure and required approvals from the local files.
observed_result: Prominent template README link, actual shared preparation/init commands, tested direct and nested portable guide links; permission context and template-uninitialized statement.

title: Uninitialized template
acceptance_criteria: Template validation confirms that no `.sys4ai/memory` state, Cognee database, project-specific memory identity, runtime log, model cache, or initialization receipt exists after documentation and skill changes.
observed_result: Actual template seven-case suite and complete protected manifest: no specialized memory identity/config, index, provider/model state, logs or receipt.

title: Independent depot memory
acceptance_criteria: The depot has reviewed project-specific configuration, a digest-bound initialization receipt, and derived storage beneath `/Volumes/P-SSD/AngryOwl/Sys4AI/.sys4ai/memory/` without borrowing the Memory Service product’s dataset or storage.
observed_result: Live sys4ai-depot/sys4ai-depot-memory configuration and accepted digest b5b34a4a... receipt; root-local private exact index and successful canonical-backed recall.

title: Child exclusion
acceptance_criteria: Root source discovery and recall tests show that content beneath independent child-project roots is absent unless a separately authorized cross-project request and canonical grant explicitly permits it.
observed_result: All Projects descendants excluded independent of registration/Git; live SQLite has zero child-source records, only root project, and explicit cross-project request is permission denied.

title: Private per-project paths
acceptance_criteria: Two independently initialized projects resolve all listed state to different roots beneath their respective projects, and neither creates or uses `~/.cognee/logs` or another account-wide memory/log directory.
observed_result: Controlled real Cognee processes use distinct data/system/cache/log/model roots and no user-wide writes; seven installed consumers have distinct private paths and 0700/0600 modes.

title: Distinct runtime and dataset identities
acceptance_criteria: Cross-project requests fail closed, each initialized runtime reports the expected project and dataset, and a two-project test finds no record, graph relation, cache entry, or provider handle crossing the boundary.
observed_result: Seven independent consumer footprints and two-provider tests; four crossed project/dataset contexts refuse and own/foreign retrieval is one/zero.

title: Preflight before derived writes
acceptance_criteria: A non-mutating preflight proves that `.sys4ai/memory`, model caches, provider paths, credentials, environments, and excluded transient files cannot enter canonical source discovery or version control before initialization apply is offered.
observed_result: Canonical preparation installs ignore/exclusion and path/secret protections; invalid paths/identity/config fail before storage; installed provider module config smoke does not import Cognee.

title: Direct no-preview bootstrap
acceptance_criteria: The canonical path produces initialized project-local Memory System state in its single authorized run; the manual path produces the equivalent state after one explicit `init-memory` invocation; neither path generates, stores, displays, or requests approval of a preview or preview digest; and required identity, path, configuration, secret, and isolation checks fail closed before writes.
observed_result: One canonical create run or manual returned init-memory argv once yields exact-ready receipt; no preview fields. All internal validation/failure atomicity cases pass.

title: Safe convergence and reruns
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover a new empty destination, an equivalent rerun, a conflicting nonempty destination, an existing registry ID/path, and a manual-template project; equivalent state is reported without duplication and conflicts stop before mutation.
observed_result: Empty/manual/occupied/duplicate/stale/failure scenarios verified; 21 forbidden commands preserve full fixture manifests, four equivalent no-ops and owned recovery verified.

title: Reviewable initialization outcomes
acceptance_criteria: A created project has a reviewable result or receipt listing actual source versions, destination paths, project and dataset IDs, checks run, pass/fail outcomes, and any deliberately deferred provider/model activation without recording secrets.
observed_result: Actual schema-checked project/asset/registry/runtime/functional-memory receipts include hashes, paths, IDs, checks and truthful deferred model/provider state without credentials.

title: Immutable per-consumer runtime
acceptance_criteria: The package artifact has a recorded version and SHA-256 digest, the consumer environment installs and loads that exact artifact without an editable sibling-path dependency or copied source tree, and later edits in the Memory Service checkout do not change the installed consumer runtime.
observed_result: Final wheel4970a7... binds source manifest f2fa121... and null own Git metadata. Root and fixtures install noneditable exact members; independent builds match hash and source edits do not change installed bytes.

title: Bounded Projects destinations
acceptance_criteria: A valid new destination beneath the registered `Projects/` container is accepted; the depot root, the template’s own path, existing unrelated paths, symlink escapes, traversal attempts, and destinations outside the depot are rejected before any filesystem or registry mutation.
observed_result: Production helper pins owning depot; direct/nested valid destinations accepted; root/template/occupied/symlink/traversal/outside and registry-substitution refusals preserve state.

title: All 16 tiered root source categories
acceptance_criteria: The root source registry covers every named source, distinguishes active root authority from reusable depot material and evidential records, preserves canonical-file reread for execution-critical state, and excludes every independent child project and all derived, environment, cache, model, secret, temporary, and raw-log paths.
observed_result: 432-row reviewed root registry distinguishes active A1/A2, ordinary A3 and evidence/reusable A5 namespaces. Six fixture tests, canonical reread tests and actual 263-source sync pass with all prohibited classes excluded.

title: Reviewed future-folder registration
acceptance_criteria: A representative eligible future root-owned folder enters memory only after a reviewed registration records its owner, relevance, path, format, namespace, canonicality, authority, trust, sensitivity, retention, and write policy; the same unregistered folder is not ingested; and child-project, derived, cache, environment, secret, temporary, and raw-log folders remain excluded.
observed_result: Installed default-deny to reviewed admission, complete metadata/current grant/hash CAS, canonical reread, own-only recall, preserved exclusions and no-op; corrected unauthorized CLI emits JSON/exit2.

title: Independent repository boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Each affected project has a recorded resolved path, observed Git top-level, repository marker, current HEAD where available, and its own protected-work baseline. An ancestor Git root is never reported as the child project repository.
Sys4AI root memory excludes Projects and every independently owned child tree regardless of registry membership or whether a Git marker is present.

Template copying excludes .git directories and gitfiles, remotes, indexes, worktree metadata, and repository history; no Git initialization or repository mutation occurs under project creation authority.
The template and Memory Service repository mismatch and the future-project Git provisioning boundary have an explicit user disposition or separate prerequisite before dependent work is accepted.
observed_result: User explicitly resolved Q-001 to current folders/Git separate. Root/Electronics own roots and HEADs inspected, template/product own Git null; source/package manifests bind product provenance. All .git metadata/protected work remains unchanged.
